note: The decision panel's own spec (T-20261016-59): the overlay machinery needs a spec named for the overlay id, listing the screens it opens over; every number of the panel is frame.json regions.panel. Each screen that opens it lists `overlays.panel` in its own spec. Panels still to come add their screen to `over`.

overlay.layer: after the screen's words, before the frame's: the veil, the panel, the title, the cards, then the ring; the message plate stands over it
overlay.beneath: the screen beneath keeps drawing under the veil and takes no key
overlay.owner: ui.panel = { screen, id, focus }; a screen change, a room key and ← clear it

focus.initial: the first card that is neither dimmed nor a loss; if every card is one or the other, the way-out card
focus.rule: ◀ ▶ the previous and next card, stopping at the ends; ▲ ▼ do nothing; the graph is not a spec graph: the face walks the props' targets in order

card.box: frame.json regions.panel.cards, one box a card

bottomLine.action: ✓ + the focused card's name + its cost
bottomLine.subject: the focused card's line, else "to {the room}" when it has a destination mark
